title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering during regional failover
author: Priya Desai
description: Background: During a multi-region outage we observed the SLO enforcer's backoff ordering interacting badly with regional failover logic which caused premature circuit breaking and cascading load-shedding. Root cause: a race between async backoff queue reordering and in-flight failover state transitions meant older backoff entries could be reapplied after thresholds were lowered, causing oscillation. This PR fixes the ordering/race and hardens the enforcer for failover scenarios. Changes: 1) Serialize backoff queue mutations via a compact compare-and-swap epoch to guarantee monotonic ordering across failover transitions. 2) Add a failover-aware guard that prevents re-applying backoff entries that predate the active failover epoch. 3) Add metrics (slo.enforcer.backoff_discarded_epoch_mismatch, slo.enforcer.epoch) and traces to help debug ordering issues. 4) Tighten the default regional failover backoff smoothing (config opt) to reduce oscillation. 5) Add focused unit + integration tests that simulate concurrent backoff/requeue during a region transition. Rollout plan: hotfix merged to main and backported to release/2026-02 within the next patch; feature gated behind runtime flag for quick rollback. Testing: unit + integration + canary run passed in staging. Impact: fixes SLO enforcement thrashing observed during incident INT-2026-02; no API changes.

discussion_summary: Root cause was an ordering race between backoff queue reorder and regional failover epoch transitions. The fix serializes queue mutations using an epoch CAS, discards stale backoff entries that predate the active epoch, exposes metrics for on-call, and tightens smoothing to reduce oscillation. Reviewers requested a microbenchmark and an on-call detection metric; both were added. CI initially flaked on a canary but passed on rerun.
release_notes: Hotfix: Fixes SLO enforcer thrashing during regional failover by ensuring backoff ordering is monotonic across failover epochs; adds metrics to detect stale backoff entries. Backported to release/2026-02.
